breakdown.description: The task is a variable-cell relaxation, but the later instruction freezes the lattice vectors and allows only internal-coordinate relaxation.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradiction: it requested a variable-cell relaxation (`vc-relax`) but then instructed to keep the lattice vectors fixed. The ground truth resolves this by removing the instruction to fix the lattice vectors. The agent's generated specification did not address this contradiction at all. Instead, it asked an unrelated clarification question about `electron_maxstep`, failing to produce a corrected task description that aligns with the ground truth.
